title: Can't see the meeting room calendar in Outlook
description: When setting up a meeting I can't select the room resources, the old calendar view doesn't show up.

worklogs.description: Confirmed 'Reviewer' permission on the room resource (for room-bigblue@corp.local).

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Which meeting rooms are you looking for? Could you share a screenshot — I'd like to see what the 'Add Room' dialog looks like.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I used to be able to see the BigBlue and SmallRed rooms. I've attached a screenshot. The location list comes up completely empty.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The location list is empty — this is related to Outlook's Address Book cache. Could you close Outlook and reopen it with the /resetnavpane parameter? (Run → outlook.exe /resetnavpane). If that doesn't work, let's also try /cleanviews.
